recipe.visualDefinition: A low-fidelity, high-contrast flash photograph of a person inside a vehicle, partially obscured by a large, out-of-focus hand reaching toward the lens. The image features a cool-toned, dark palette with heavy grain and cinematic motion blur.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground hand vs. background subject depth-of-field contrast
Cool blue-black shadows vs. warm skin highlights
Fluid script typography vs. harsh photographic grain
Tight car interior framing vs. expansive motion blur
coreInvariants: Extreme shallow depth of field focusing on the background subject
Heavy film grain and digital noise
Cool-toned color grading with crushed blacks
A hand gesture blocking the camera view

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is mid-ground, left-aligned; the secondary subject (hand) is extreme foreground, right-aligned and oversized.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, blurred hand in the foreground acts as the primary visual anchor due to its scale and luminosity.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bright foreground hand to the subject's face in the background, then down to the script lettering in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark, underexposed negative space in the car interior and bottom corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and charcoal blacks provide the atmospheric base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale, desaturated skin tones provide the primary light source.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white used for typography and sharp specular highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; shadows are deep and desaturated while highlights are blown out.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with long, sweeping flourishes
letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width mimicking a fine-liner pen
Open loops in ascenders and descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letters feature exaggerated, wide-sweeping tails
Lowercase 't' crossbars are integrated into the flow of the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the fluid script with a small, rigid sans-serif block for metadata or advisory labels.

preserve: The sweeping horizontal scale of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, hand-written feel of the original
Captures the thin stroke and modern aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic, grainy photo of a person in a dark car interior at night, shot with a harsh flash. A large, out-of-focus hand is in the extreme foreground, reaching toward the camera, creating a sense of motion and privacy-seeking. Use cool blue and black tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin, elegant, white hand-drawn script title in the bottom right corner, overlapping the blurred hand. Ensure the script has long, horizontal flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the foreground hand significantly more blurred than the background face?
Is the color palette dominated by cool, dark tones?
Does the typography feel like a personal signature?
Is there visible film grain across the entire image?

adjustableVariables: Degree of blue-tint in the shadows
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any recognizable brand logos on clothing or car parts
Exact text content of the advisory label
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'crushed' blacks in the shadow areas
Ensure the script is legible despite its thin weight
Verify the hand gesture feels candid rather than posed
Confirm the grain doesn't obscure the subject's expression
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-flash candid photo with extreme foreground blur and a delicate, oversized script signature in the lower third.
